note: Zoom on the chalkboard ledge of the second alphabet room. The feminine words (la phrase, l'orthographe) are the train and the giraffe on the left; the masculine ones (le mot, l'accent) are the moth and the beret man on the right. Divider offset to 740 because the giraffe stands just right of the centre. The blank card pinned on the wall is the sign.
